name: Rattle them
engine: Beat a man, tackle him cleanly or make him foul, and he is rattled until he wins one back: go at him with two dice, and the captain keeps at him.
about: A man of theirs who is beaten or fouls stays rattled until he wins a duel against you, and every part of this team feeds on that. Yamal and Baena (wingers) and Olmo (carrier) run at their men: Run at him rattles anyone a run beats cleanly, and a winger or carrier rattles him on a half win too. Yamal draws fouls, and the man who fouls him is booked and rattled. On their attack, Rodri and Laporte are clean tacklers: the man they take it from cleanly is rattled. Go at the booked man rolls two dice on your runs at a booked or rattled man, and on your tackles against a rattled attacker. The captain, Rodri, points out every man your components rattle: once an attack, a half win against him counts as a clean win. When you lose the ball going forward, Rodri presses at once.
